The question we are asking fans today: Which position in the 2026/27 Premier League table do you predict Newcastle United to finish in?

Hand on heart, in which place do you think Newcastle United will end up in, after the final round of matches on Sunday 30 May 2027?

The last four seasons have seen Eddie Howe and his players finish the season in 4th, 7th, 5th and 12th places.

No European distractions this time.

Eddie Howe and the Newcastle United players having the 38 Premier League matches to contend with, plus the two domestic cup competitions.

The 2026/27 Premier League fixtures are to be released at 10am on Friday 19 June 2026.

Whilst four days before that the Premier League summer 2026 transfer window officially opens.

The big question though is in 12 months time, where do you predict United will have finished in the 2026/27 Premier League season?

The poll is now closed and the FINAL RESULTS CAN NOW BE VIEWED.

Dates for Newcastle United fans to note:

Wednesday 10 June 2026
New 2026/27 Newcastle United Home Shirt to be launched

Monday 15 June 2026
Premier League summer transfer window opens

Friday 19 June 2026
Premier League fixtures released at 10am for the 2026/27 season

Monday 30 June 2026
End of the Newcastle United 2025/26 season financial year

Monday 13 July 2026
Newcastle United squad report back to the training ground to begin pre-season preparations.

(A pre-season training camp at La Manga has been confirmed by the club but no dates as yet.)

Wednesday 12 August 2026
Newcastle v Everton pre-season friendly with 5.15pm kick-off at Murrayfield.

Weekend of Saturday 15 August 2026
The usual pair of friendlies at St James’ Park are expected. No dates or times announced as yet, nor the opposition teams, but AS Roma and Strasbourg have been rumoured.

Saturday 22 August 2026
This weekend sees the opening round of 2026/27 Premier League fixtures played.

Tuesday 1 September 2026
Premier League transfer window closes at 11pm.

Friday 1 January 2027
Mid-season transfer window opens.

Monday 1 February 2027
Mid-season transfer window closes at 11pm.

Sunday 30 May 2027
Final round of 2026/27 Premier League matches.
